set.body: Build ScalaFIM support for fmrilatent's core idea as a typed latent response layer: time-by-samples data represented by coefficient time series plus explicit or decoder-backed projection into image/surface/native domains. Scope: portable latent algebra, explicit basis/loadings/offset responses, least-squares projection semantics, dataset/archive bridges, transport linear-map handoff, and later BOLDZip decoder payloads. Non-goals for the first slice: R S4/S3 API shape, mutable registries, and production BOLDZip encoding.
set.title: Epic: Scala latent fMRI core
